RIYADH: Startups across the Middle East and North Africa saw new funding rounds over the past week, with acquisitions, and partnerships across artificial intelligence, fintech, gaming, and digital infrastructure.

	Saudi Arabia-based Signit raised $15 million in a series A round led by Raed Ventures

articles.title: ChatGPT was down globally, here’s what the company has to say
articles.summary: ChatGPT experienced an outage, with 91% of users facing issues. OpenAI acknowledged the problem, and the service is now back online with performance back to normal. The TOI Tech team verified the restoration on the website and mobile app.
